narr: Monsoon thunderstorms produced heavy rain and hail in the form of 1 to 2 plus inches of rainfall in the Albuquerque metro area. This resulted in numerous reports of flash flooding in the northeastern area of Albuquerque. Strong wind gusts were also observed at sites across the White Sands Missile Range.
ev: Two rounds of thunderstorms produced heavy rain over the highlighted area that resulted in several reports of flash flooding impacts. Flash flooding forced debris over the roadway at the intersection Montgomery and Carlisle with rocks greater than 5 inches in diameter, and street flooding also observed at Moon and Menaul. High water rises were observed on area arroyos resulting in swift water rescue being deployed with two people able to self-rescue. I-40 westbound also saw two lanes close near San Pedro for emergency repairs. There was also 6 inches of standing water on the bridge over the Hahn Arroyo, with water also reaching the base of a pedestrian bridge over I-40 near San Mateo.
lsr: Debris across roadway at intersection of Montgomery and Carlisle including rocks >5 inches in diameter - clear evidence of significant overland flow.
